::: {#exm-strongly-connected}
#### Following the links

The directed graph of @exm-web-links is strongly connected (@def-strongly-connected).
The walk home, about, contact, home goes from home to about and to contact and back,
and the edges $(\text{home}, \text{blog})$ and $(\text{blog}, \text{home})$ join home and blog both ways.
So there is a walk from every page to home, and from home to every page,
and following one walk after the other goes from any page to any other.

If the contact page lost its link to home, the graph would not be strongly connected:
no edge would start at contact, so there would be no walk from contact to any other page.

:::
